concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-risk-and-security-risk-factors-identifying-fraud]] - manual merchant investigation checklist for customer, address, email, IP and transaction-pattern indicators, with an explicit guidance-not-proof boundary and conditional contact, fulfillment and void/refund next steps
warnings: This source is a manual risk-factor guide, not evidence of a Fraud Protection product decision, merchant eligibility, current support, or a guaranteed fraud outcome.
Its suggested void/refund action is conditional and framed as reducing chargeback likelihood, not preventing chargebacks.
